summary: ING Groep N.V. filed a 6-K on August 25, 2026, attaching a press release updating progress on its €1.0 billion share buyback programme announced on 30 April 2026. The release reports that during the week of 17–21 August 2026, ING repurchased 1,755,612 shares at an average price of €30.24, for a total of €53,093,324.65. Cumulative repurchases under the programme are 22,495,805 shares at an average price of €27.45, totalling €617,405,614.49, approximately 61.74% of the programme's maximum value. The programme's purpose is to reduce share capital. What to watch: continued weekly progress toward completion of the buyback.
